$comment: Monthly cloud budgets for Health Watchers. Consumed by scripts/cost/cost-report.sh and applied to AWS Budgets via `aws budgets create-budget`. Alert thresholds fire to #cost-alerts and the Finance partner. At 100% of a NON-prod budget, ops/cost automation scales non-prod workloads to zero overnight; prod never auto-actions.

budgets.name: production
budgets.notes: Breach pages Platform on-call. No automatic remediation on prod.

budgets.name: dr
budgets.notes: Warm-standby capacity. Do not throttle — it is the recovery target.

budget_actions.description: kubectl scale deploy --all --replicas=0 in non-prod namespaces via the cost-guardrails CronJob; restored next business morning.
SCP/OPA policy blocks new NAT gateways, GPU instances, and >x-large nodes until a human clears the alert.
PagerDuty notify Platform; manual review in the cost channel.
